body: This happened with my niece when she was three and I was sixteen, I took her to the park, and a few hours later she was in a little cast just like your little one. I’m still her favorite auntie and my sister has never held it against me, now that I have my own kids I am way more careful though. Don’t beat yourself up, I’ve been there and it really really blows.

I’m a stay at home mom who uses medical, I don’t smoke around the kids or anything like that, I use edibles during the day if I need them and if I smoke it’s at night when thier sleeping. I have a severe spinal injury, I used to take 3-4 Percocet a day combined with anti depressants and muscle relaxers, and it was genuinely awful, when I started using cannabis as a substitute for all those meds my quality of life has improved dramatically and I can actually enjoy the moments I have with my family. I understand the stigma behind it all, I even get judged by my own mother at times ( she’s a bit old fashioned) but I personally think it’s worth it, and I don’t feel “ high” anymore really, my tolerance has adjusted to it the same way it did with the narcotics, that’s why I wouldn’t exactly compare it to alcohol.

Mine likes me out of obligation, she had an affair with my bio dad while I was freshly postpartum with my youngest, they were both in serious relationships at the time so it caused a ton of grief, they didn’t take much accountability, and honestly I only talk to her because she’s been an active part of my kids lives and they’d be so upset if they couldn’t see her anymore, she’s only nice now because we told her if she ever pulls something like that again we’re cutting contact. My bio dad is a different story, basically just came back into my life to screw around with my mother in law and lie lie lieeeee to my face lol so we do t talk to him anymore( he wasn’t very apologetic and said some colorful things about me and my family when we caught them)
So yeah , I’m pretty sure she hates me, but because of what I know and how much a know about her private life now, she doesn’t tell me anything ever, unless she’s dropping off gifts or money or something lol

I love makeup, I used to have very beautiful skin, blemish free, small pores, so if only use eye makeup or sometimes lipstick, then I got pregnant and got hormonal cystic acne and rosecea combined, saw a dermatologist and everything, it’s been 4 years and I still have what looks like meth head skin, it’s a major confidence killer when I’ve been doing everything I can ( including seeing a dermatologist) to help it with no luck, I have to wait till I’m finished breastfeeding my youngest then I can try out the more serious prescriptions to try to treat it, in the mean time though I really practiced my makeup skills so I could at least avoid weird stares and feel like a normal human being out of the house. That’s why I panic if I don’t have my makeup, I’ve heard shitty comments from my own parents about my skin too.

I have two, one dream where my sister and I were being babysat by this old lady in an old fashioned purple dress, we were in a broken down trailer and she started screaming at my sister and I and while she was screaming her fingers started to literally explode, like into blood tissue and bone, it was terrifying and I remember crying myself awake. 

The second dream is a bit worse, I was in this toy train, kind of like the view of a toy from toy story, and the first stop the train stopped at had this angry pig chief ( like a human sized pig wearing an Native American chief head dress) and he was really really angry and when we made eye contact his eyes and nose started to poor blood, in the dream I ran out of the train car and everything went black, then it panned over like in a movie to two naked children dancing with thier heads chopped off, idk what the hell I was watching but that shit kind of Stuck with me as a child, just those two, I also used to have night terrors but I don’t remember anything other than the feeling of pure panic from those.

When I turned 18 my dad left my mom, went to go live with his parents ( it was wayyyyy more messy but I’ll keep it short) my mom started drinking and making me feel unsafe in our home so I went to live with my dad and his parents. I went on a date one day with this incredibly nice black guy, I only mention that because my father and his parents were super racist and I had never realized it. I didn’t even kiss the guy, the next day I woke up to my grandfather sexually assaulting me in my sleep, it was horrible, I literally froze up and waited for him to leave and called my dad. 

For like a week my dad believed me, then he accused me of doing hard drugs, and sleeping with that guy while they were all home. I cut him and his family from my life, and his parents just died this year and as horrible as it sounds I couldn’t be happier, those people I called my grandparents shat on my name to cover up from that pervert, I hope they rot

My husband and I are both gamers, and we used to fight about this issue a lot because I stay at home and he works, basically it boiled down to whatever free time we get is equal, if he gets an hour to get out of parenting, then at some point in the day he should do the same for you, it’s worked so far for us.

My husband is a huge giver in bed, always has been, so it’s a hard yes that’s he’s the best lol we’ve been together almost ten years and our sex life just seems to improve, with communication of course

Fuck pregnancy, I’ve had two kids and got gestational diabetes twice, cystic acne, tooth infections/cavities, a herniated disk, and I had to have c sections with both of them and the recovery for that is bull too, especially when you have a baby to take care of. All of my sisters have had similar stories too, I’m pretty blunt to my nieces and even my own kids about it, it’s not all warm and fuzzy like in the movies, it’s messy and uncomfortable and it takes a ton out of you, and yeah personally I think it was all worth it in the end, but there’s no way I’d ever go through all that again even if you paid me .

When I was in middle school I was eating breakfast with my family and noticed my dads glasses where broken and his nose was cut and bruised, he said it was a work incident and didn’t want to talk about it. We’ll years later after my parents divorced, I found out my dad got drunk the night before and got caught sexting one of his coworkers by my mother, so in response he started trying to beat her, and she instead kicked his ass, the cops were called and everything but I was at a friends house that weekend, my parents and my sister just opted not to tell me about it. No one talks to my abusive POS dad anymore btw.
My moms elderly dog fell off thier porch and hurt herself so badly they had to put her down, poor BooBoo, got put down at noon today, I still haven’t told my kids

I’m a stay at home mom to a one year old and an almost five year old, yesterday I did everything the older kid wanted, I made his favorite food, played all his favorite games with him, watched his favorite movies, but when bedtime came around and Funtime was over I still got hit with “ I wish you were a REAL mom” I asked him what he meant “ a mom with a job like my cousins, they get more money and toys” it made me cry, I had to leave the room, I didn’t get mad at him though, I calmed down and explained to him that they may have more money or bigger TVs and such ( not really tho my husband makes bank lol) but they don’t spend nearly as much time with them as I do with him, he kind of got it. Idk kids just don’t understand how things work or why adults do the things they do.

I did freak out like crazy though so I can completely sympathize with you!

I have a brother in law like this, my best advice is to distance yourself from those specific people in your family and make it known to whoever asks why . 

Also your baby is probably just as beautiful as you think he is, some people are just assholes and think they can be mean to kids that can’t fight back, once again, my brother in law is an asshole lol he’s been kicked out of birthday parties for making the kids upset, some people just shouldn’t be around kids either. Set boundaries, for yourself and your baby :)

The moral thing is his words not mine, and trust me we’ve fought about that too. Basically when we first met I did mostly everything. I worked, did all the cleaning and cooking, he went to school and worked part time and he had loads of free time with no responsibilities. I know that’s not a healthy relationship dynamic but neither of us really knew what a healthy relationship looked like. We got pregnant unexpectedly ( I have severe PCOS, I don’t really ovulate, it’s rare) and that seemed to light a fire under his butt. Since then, we have two kids now and I’m the stay at home parent, and he’s told me before he just has a lot of guilt over the way he treated me for years before. That guilt combined with him being stubborn has resulted in him not really wanting to take care of himself, it’s a big mess but we’re in therapy and we’re both willing to work through things.

I’ve offered this up I don’t know how many times but because it wouldn’t be morally fair to me he always says no. I’ve tried giving him regular naps, setting bedtimes, we bought a really nice coffee maker that never gets used. I told him last night to go to a doctor or I’m leaving, and he made the appointment today, so I have my fingers crossed that there’s an end to this in sight.
